tray.shortcut_none: not assigned: every variant is taken
selection.no_window: I do not see a window with selected text. Select text in another program and press the shortcut again.
selection.blind: This window is in the blind zone (passwords, sign-in, bank, payment): I do not take its text.
selection.empty: Nothing is selected: select text and press the shortcut again.
selection.window_gone: The window where the text was selected is already closed.
selection.title: Selected text · {app}
error.name_long: The name is longer than 24 characters
chat.mic_title: Allow the microphone. Recording starts only after you press the button or the keys
chat.screen_title: Allow looking at the screen. A screenshot is taken only while you ask for it
chat.new_title: New conversation: this chat will be forgotten
chat.setup: For {name} to answer, set a provider and a key.
chat.empty: Write what to do. For example: “what time is it?”
confirm.timer_title: Without an answer the action will be denied
confirm.always_title: Do not ask again for this action
confirm.always_high: A high-risk action cannot be allowed forever
confirm.always_wide: The target has “*”: a permanent rule would cover too much
confirm.hint: You can answer in the chat: “yes”, “always allow”, “no”.
confirm.hint_no_always: You can answer in the chat: “yes”, “no”.
confirm.untranslated: The description below is still in Russian in this version.
core.answer_hint: First answer the question about the action: “yes”, “always allow” or “no”.
provider.tg_question_unseen: This question is open on the computer and was never sent here, so I did not take your message as an answer. Here it is. Answer with a button or in text: “yes” or “no”.
provider.tg_voice_question_unseen: A question about an action is open on the computer right now. Such questions are not answered by voice. Send me any text message and I will show the question here.
settings.title: Settings
persona.lead: Looks, character and the name she answers to.
persona.name: Name
persona.model_license: Terms of use from the file: {license}
persona.model_failed: The model is not shown; the built-in avatar is.
persona.model_fail_load: The model file did not load.
persona.model_stills_failed: The portraits for the chips did not come out: the chips show what they had.
persona.slots_lead: Which expression of the model shows each emotion. “Auto” chooses by itself.
persona.look_scale_lead: The mouse wheel over her on the desktop changes the size too.
persona.motions_lead: Your own .vrma files: dances, poses, gestures. Mika plays them when asked.
persona.custom_placeholder: Describe the character in your own words
providers.lead: Any service connects by an address and a key.
models.search: Search: name, maker, a word from the description
models.loading: Asking the provider for the list…
models.all: The provider does not say what the models can do: the whole list is shown.
models.capped: the first {count} are shown, narrow it with the search
voices.known: The provider does not return a list of voices: these are the voices of this model family from its description. Click a voice to pick it, ▶ to listen.
voices.none: The provider does not return a list of voices, and I do not know them for this model: type a voice name from its description.
providers.key_hint: The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager and never gets into the settings files.
permissions.lead: Rules you gave with the “Always allow” button. Any of them can be revoked.
permissions.none: No rules: {name} asks before every action.
tools.lead: What she is allowed to use.
tools.web_sub: Search, reading pages and weather. Requests go to DuckDuckGo and Open-Meteo. Opening a link in the browser works without this.
tools.later: The microphone will come with voice input and will also stay off until you turn it on.
general.autostart_sub: {name} will appear as the island after you sign in.
general.shortcut: Open the chat from the keyboard
hotkeys.lead: Keyboard shortcuts that work in any program, and two actions they start.
hotkeys.press: Press the new shortcut. Esc cancels
hotkeys.status_off: turns on together with the action
hotkeys.hint: A letter or a digit needs two keys out of Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win, for example Ctrl+Alt+D. For F1–F12 one is enough: Ctrl, Alt or Win. A shortcut held by Windows or by another program cannot be assigned.
hotkeys.err_no_key: A key is needed, not only Ctrl, Alt, Shift or Win
hotkeys.err_modifier: Add keys: a letter or a digit needs two out of Ctrl, Alt, Shift and Win, F1–F12 need Ctrl, Alt or Win
hotkeys.err_reserved: This shortcut is taken by a usual Windows command
hotkeys.err_same: This shortcut already belongs to the action “{action}”
hotkeys.err_taken: The shortcut {combo} is taken by another program, the previous one is kept
dictation.sub: Press {shortcut} and say a phrase: the text is typed where the cursor is, in any program. After a short press the recording ends by itself when you fall silent, or on a second press. If you hold the keys, the recording goes on until you release them. No longer than 45 seconds. The text is typed as it is, without the model, and Enter is not pressed. The sound of the phrase goes to the speech recognition provider, and this is paid. In windows with passwords, sign-in, bank and payment, in a password field and where the field could not be checked, dictation does not record and does not type; the window title is checked, so the protection is not complete.
dictation.needs_mic: Dictation needs “Microphone”: turn it on in the chat header or on the “Voice” page.
dictation.needs_stt: Dictation needs a speech recognition model: the “Voice” page.
dictation.err_busy: Dictation will wait: first I will finish what I am busy with.
dictation.err_no_window: Dictation: I do not see a window to type into.
dictation.err_own_window: Dictation types into other programs. My own window has a microphone button.
dictation.err_blind: Dictation: the window in front is in the blind zone (passwords, sign-in, bank, payment). I record nothing and type nothing.
dictation.err_password: Dictation: the cursor is in a password field. I record nothing and type nothing.
dictation.err_unsure: Dictation: I could not check whether this is a password field. I record nothing and type nothing. Try again.
dictation.err_keys_held: Dictation: the keys stayed pressed, the text was not typed.
screen_ask.sub: Press {shortcut}: I will capture only the window that is in front right now and show the screenshot in the chat. Write or say a question; without a question I will explain what is on the screen. The screenshot and the question go to the provider of the vision model and are processed there; the screenshot is not saved to disk. Windows with passwords, sign-in, bank and payment are not captured; the window title is checked, so the protection is not complete.
screen_ask.needs_screen: The question about the screen needs “Screen”: turn it on in the chat header or on the “Tools” page.
screen_ask.placeholder: Explain what is on the screen
screen_ask.question: Question about the screenshot
screen_ask.sends: The screenshot of this window will go to the provider of the vision model.
screen_ask.err_off: The question about the screen is off: settings, the “Shortcuts” page.
screen_ask.err_busy: The question about the screen will wait: first I will finish what I am busy with.
screen_ask.err_setup: Question about the screen: finish the setup first, I did not keep the screenshot.
screen_ask.err_screen_off: Screen viewing is off. Turn on the “Screen” switch in the chat header.
screen_ask.err_no_window: I do not see a window that can be captured.
screen_ask.err_own_window: My own window is in front. Switch to the program you need and press the shortcut again.
screen_ask.err_blind: This window is in the blind zone (passwords, sign-in, bank, payment): I do not capture it.
screen_ask.err_gone: The screenshot is gone. Press the shortcut again in the window you need.
tools.notify_on_sub: She sees new Windows notifications and remembers them in the conversation: you can say “answer him”. Notifications of banks, codes and passwords are not read. Also needed for watching a chat.
tools.notify_messengers_sub: Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, mail and the like. Turn it off to see the notifications of all programs.
tools.notify_aloud_sub: When speaking replies is on, she says who the notification is from and what is in it.
tools.briefing_sub: After the set time, when you are at the computer: weather, the to-do list and reminders for today, rates, top news.
error.briefing_time: The summary time has the form HH:MM, for example 08:30.
life.morning: Good morning! I'm here if you need anything.|Good morning!|Morning! Have a good day.
life.day: Welcome back!|Here again — good to see you!|Hi again!
life.evening: Good evening!|Welcome back. How was your day?|Evening!
life.night: Can't sleep?|I'm here at night too. How can I help?
life.late: It's late already. Time to rest, maybe?|It's past midnight — don't stay up too long.|It's late. Tomorrow is another day.
rhythm.break: {min} minutes without a break already. Stand up, stretch, look into the distance.|{min} minutes of work — time for a short break.|{min} minutes have passed. Five minutes of rest?
calendar.not_ics: the link does not lead to an ICS calendar
costs.lead: What the paid calls to providers cost and what their budget is.
costs.on_sub: Every paid call to a provider is recorded on this computer: kind, model, tokens, characters, seconds and money, if the price is known. The texts of requests and the keys are not recorded.
costs.units_only: The price is unknown, there are only units
costs.other_currency: Costs in another or an unknown currency are shown separately and do not count in the budget: Mika does not convert currencies.
costs.blind_n: The provider did not report tokens or duration: {count}
costs.currency_auto: The currency was taken from the address of the main model's provider. After saving it does not change by itself.
costs.currency_assumed: The provider of the main model does not report a currency: costs without a currency are counted in the budget currency.
costs.budget_hint: 0 — no limit. Mika will warn at 80% and at 100%. She answers your requests after 100% too: the limit does not block them.
costs.pause: At 100% pause the paid work she starts herself
costs.pause_sub: When the daily or the monthly limit is reached, Mika does not start by herself what costs money: event scenarios, scheduled tasks, the morning summary and the evening summary, replies in chats for you. A skipped scenario run does not count in its daily count. A scheduled task will come as a reminder but will not be carried out. The chat, voice, shortcuts, buttons in the settings and your messages from Telegram work as usual. Mika will tell you about the pause once per day or month.
costs.paused_day: Paused now: the daily limit is reached. Mika does not start paid work on her own until tomorrow.
costs.paused_month: Paused now: the monthly limit is reached. Mika does not start paid work on her own until next month.
costs.prices_hint: Mika takes the price from the provider's reply, then from its list of models. If it is not there either, set your own for the model in the list above.
costs.prices_never: The price list has not been read yet: it is read after the first paid call.
costs.alert_day_80: Spent today: {spent} of {limit}. That is {share}% of the daily limit.
costs.alert_day_100: The daily cost limit is used up: {spent} of {limit}. I answer your requests as usual.
costs.alert_month_80: Spent since the start of the month: {spent} of {limit}. That is {share}% of the monthly limit.
costs.alert_month_100: The monthly cost limit is used up: {spent} of {limit}. I answer your requests as usual.
costs.pause_day: The daily cost limit is reached: {spent} of {limit}. Until tomorrow I do not start paid work on my own: event scenarios, scheduled tasks, summaries, replies in chats for you. I answer your requests as usual. You can raise the limit or turn the pause off in the settings, the “Costs” page.
costs.pause_month: The monthly cost limit is reached: {spent} of {limit}. Until next month I do not start paid work on my own: event scenarios, scheduled tasks, summaries, replies in chats for you. I answer your requests as usual. You can raise the limit or turn the pause off in the settings, the “Costs” page.
error.costs_limit: The limit is a number from 0 to a billion
error.costs_currency: The currency is roubles, dollars or euros
error.costs_price: Set at least one price above zero
error.costs_prices: The price list was not read: {why}
day.evening_sub: After the set time, when you are at the computer: where the time went, what was done, what was in the calendar, and a suggested plan for tomorrow. The facts of the day go to the model in one short request.
day.evening_started: I am putting the summary together, it will appear in the chat.
day.empty:
There is nothing to sum up today: no records for the day.
Counting time in programs is turned on in the settings, the “Tools” page.
day.head: Day summary:
error.evening_busy: Mika is busy now. Try again when she has answered
error.evening_failed: The day summary was not put together: {why}
tools.focus_sub: During focus she keeps quiet: she holds notifications back, says nothing about breaks, gives no greetings, and the morning summary waits. At the end she lists what came in. By voice too: “turn on focus for an hour”.
tools.breaks_sub: If work goes on without a pause longer than the set time, she suggests a rest. A pause of 5 minutes starts the count again.
tools.lively_sub: She says hello when you come back after half an hour, says it is late at night, is glad when a to-do is done and when focus ends. The model is not called for this.
tools.app_time_sub: Every 15 seconds the program in front is noted while you are at the computer. Only the program name is kept, without window titles, only on this computer, for 60 days. Ask “how much time went on the browser today”.
tools.clipboard_sub: The last 50 copied texts, in memory only until exit. Passwords, keys, codes and copies from bank and sign-in windows are not saved. Ask “what was in the clipboard an hour ago”. The text that is found goes to the model with the answer.
tools.calendar_sub: A secret ICS link is needed. Google Calendar: “Settings → your calendar → Integrate calendar → Secret address in iCal format”. Outlook: “Settings → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar”, the ICS link. The link is kept in Windows Credential Manager. Meetings also go into the morning summary.
tools.calendar_url_set: The link is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
tools.calendar_remind: Remind before a meeting, min (0 — off)
tools.docs_sub: Folders she answers questions about: “what does the contract say about penalties”. She reads txt, md, csv, html, docx and pdf (pdf by recognising pages, up to 60). With the embeddings model from the “Memory” page she searches by meaning, without it by words. The passages that are found go to the model with the question.
error.calendar_url: The calendar link must start with https:// or webcal://
general.wipe_text: Delete everything: keys from Credential Manager, settings, history, memory, notes, reminders, rules, the log and autostart. The app will close.
journal.lead: What the app did and what failed. The log stays on this computer.
journal.crash: The previous run ended unexpectedly. The log shows what happened before that.
journal.crash_here: The previous run ended unexpectedly, and the log has a warning about it. The rows before it show what was going on.
journal.search_title: Search the text of the rows
journal.follow_title: New rows appear by themselves while the page is open
journal.capped: The latest rows are shown: {count}. Find the rest with the filter or save the log to a file.
journal.size: The log takes {size}, files: {files}, rows since {since}.
journal.content_sub: Without this the log holds only tool names, durations, sizes, outcomes and the errors of the app itself and of providers; the text of a tool error is hidden. Keys and blind zone windows are never written.
journal.content_warn: The log will start to hold the beginning of your messages (typed, spoken and from Telegram) and of the replies, tool arguments and the texts of tool errors: these can hold window titles, file paths, search queries and text to be typed. Dictated text is not written. Mika can read these rows with the “log” tool, and then they go to the model provider. Turn it on while you look for the cause of a failure, and remember it when you show the log to someone else.
journal.keep_sub: Earlier log files are removed by themselves: by age and when their number exceeds {files}. The current file starts over at 5 MB, so rows in it can stay longer than that; “Clear” removes everything at once.
lang.name: English
lang.title: Interface language
lang.sub: With the English interface {name} answers in the language you write in. Confirmation cards, tool lines and some errors are still in Russian in this version.
lang.error: No such interface language: ru or en
error.vosk_checksum: The checksum of the downloaded file did not match, the file was deleted
error.vosk_unpack: The model archive did not unpack
error.vosk_incomplete: Model files are missing after unpacking
error.feed_url: The feed address must start with http:// or https://
error.mcp_empty: A name and a start command are needed
research.title: Deep search
research.sub: Mika makes up the queries herself, reads several pages and writes a report with links. The queries go to DuckDuckGo, the page texts go to the model. Before a search she asks for permission and names the limits. “Always allow” holds while the limits, the model and the folder do not change, and only for one search at a time, not more often than once in 10 minutes and not more than five a day: Mika asks about the others. The internet tools are needed.
research.model_hint: Empty — the same as for replies
research.model_sub: Almost the whole price of a search goes to it: pick an inexpensive one.
research.calls: One search: up to {n} paid calls to the model {model}.
research.estimate: Tokens are counted approximately, by the number of characters: the provider does not give an exact count. Reasoning that the model writes in the reply itself is counted. Hidden reasoning that the provider sends separately is not seen by Mika: it does not count in the limit but is paid for. A model without reasoning is better for the search.
research.high: More than 100 thousand tokens per search: Mika will ask every time, “Always allow” is not available.
research.folder_high: The reports folder is in a system place: Mika will ask every time.
research.card_unread: Not read or not useful: {n}. The list is at the end of the report.
research.card_unsourced: Places without a source: {n}. They are marked in the report.
research.card_limit_time: The time ran out before everything was read: the report is incomplete.
research.card_limit_tokens: The token limit ran out before everything was read: the report is incomplete.
research.card_note: Put together by the model from pages on the internet. Check what matters by the links in the report.
error.research_folder: The reports folder is set wrongly: an ordinary path to a folder on this computer is needed
chat.unpin_title: Unpin: an ordinary window of any size. You can also just pull the island down
providers.vision_sub: The model that looks at screenshots
providers.vision_model: Vision model (empty — the same as for replies)
providers.image_url: Address for pictures (empty — as for replies)
providers.image_key: Key for pictures (empty — as for replies)
tools.screen_sub: Screenshots of the screen and of windows for “what is on the screen” questions and for reading text from a picture. A screenshot is taken only while you ask for it. Windows with passwords and payments are not captured; only the window title is checked, so the protection is not complete.
tools.groups_sub: A tool group that is off is not offered to the model: requests are shorter and cheaper.
tools.ffmpeg_sub: Needed by the “Video and sound” tools. Mika looks for it at the path below, then in PATH, then in her own folder.
tools.ffmpeg_gpl: This is a GPL build. Mika runs it as a separate program.
tools.ffmpeg_offer: FFmpeg is a separate program of the FFmpeg project (ffmpeg.org) under the LGPL v3 license. Mika will download the FFmpeg 9.0 build ({size} MB) from github.com/FFmpeg-Builds into %LOCALAPPDATA%\Mika\ffmpeg and check it by SHA-256. Mika is not part of the FFmpeg project.
tools.ffmpeg_license: Uses FFmpeg (ffmpeg.org) under LGPL v3, build github.com/FFmpeg-Builds, source code git.ffmpeg.org/ffmpeg.git, version 7adfbe40dc.
tools.ffmpeg_path_hint: Empty — search PATH and Mika's folder. You can give ffmpeg.exe or the folder with it
tools.ffmpeg_path_bad: There is no ffmpeg.exe with ffprobe.exe next to it at this path. For now I search PATH and Mika's folder.
chat.ffmpeg_done: FFmpeg is ready. Repeat the request.
chat.ffmpeg_or_path: Or give the path to your own FFmpeg in Settings → Tools.
error.ffmpeg_host: The download address led to a foreign server, the download was stopped
error.ffmpeg_size: The size of the archive is not the expected one, the file was deleted
error.ffmpeg_checksum: The checksum of the downloaded file did not match, the file was deleted
error.ffmpeg_unpack: The FFmpeg archive did not unpack
error.ffmpeg_incomplete: FFmpeg files are missing after unpacking
error.ffmpeg_in_use: FFmpeg is working now. Wait until it ends or press “Stop”
bgjob.stop_title: Stop the job. The unfinished file will be deleted, the finished ones will stay
rec.stop_title: Stop the recording and save the file
group.system: System: volume, volume of programs, power, the clipboard and its history, processes, “why is it slow”, time in programs, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, brightness, the log of the app
group.apps: Programs and windows: starting, closing, switching, keyboard layout, messages and auto-reply in Telegram
group.files: Files: search by name and inside files, questions about documents, what takes up space, reading, writing, moving, the recycle bin, archives, batch operations
group.browser: Mika's browser: open, read, click, fill in (its own profile)
group.web: Internet: search, deep search with a report, pages, weather, rates, news
group.daily: Reminders, timers, to-do list, calendar, focus, day summary, provider costs
group.memory: Memory: facts about you and past conversations
group.media: Player: pause, next track, what is playing
group.av: Video and sound: details, format, compression, cutting, joining, GIF, rotation, speed, sound processing, subtitles, speech to text, what is in a video, whole folders, background jobs, screen recording
group.windows: Window control: reading, clicks, typing, keys
group.screen: Screen: a question about a screenshot, text from a picture, a click by a picture, a screenshot
group.events: Events and watching: event scenarios, “tell me when…”
events.title: Event scenarios
events.sub: Mika carries out your command or instruction when something happens: headphones are connected, a program is started, you step away. Every action of a scenario still asks for permission. Mika watches only your Windows session and only what the scenarios that are on need.
events.enable_sub: Turn it off to pause all scenarios. Runs per hour for all scenarios together: {n} at most. Every run is a call to the model, like your message in the chat: with a paid provider it is paid.
events.none: No scenarios. Say in the chat: “when I connect headphones, turn on the music” or “when I close the game, bring the volume back”.
events.command_text: What the custom command says now. Mika runs this text when the scenario fires
events.limits: pause {pause}, up to {max} a day, today {count}
events.waits_sub: What you asked to be told about. A watch lives while Mika is running. The outcome comes to the chat, as a Windows notification and to Telegram, if the bridge is on.
events.waits_none: I am not watching anything. Say in the chat: “tell me when the file is downloaded” or “tell me when the build is finished”.
island.lead: What is shown while idle and when the island hides.
island.city_sub: The weather is shown while idle if the internet tools are on. A request goes out every 30 minutes. Mika takes the same city when asked about the weather without a city name.
island.games_sub: While a full-screen program is in front (a game, a video, a maximized window), the island and the avatar go behind it. Keyboard shortcuts or your voice bring them back to the top.
memory.lead: What she remembers about you. Any fact can be deleted.
memory.none: Nothing remembered yet. Say “remember that…” or add a fact yourself.
memory.add_placeholder: A new fact in one phrase
memory.archive_sub: Messages in the archive: {count}. She searches them when you ask about the past. “New conversation” moves the chat to the archive.
memory.embed_sub: An embeddings model finds facts and past conversations by meaning, not by matching words. Without a model the search goes by words. Texts for the search go to the embeddings provider.
ext.lead: Custom commands, schedule, MCP servers and Telegram.
ext.commands_sub: Type the name of a command in the chat and she follows its steps. Every action still asks for permission.
ext.command_prompt: What to do, step by step
ext.schedule_none: Nothing is scheduled. Say “remind me in 10 minutes…” or “tell me the weather every day at 9:00”.
ext.mcp_sub: External tools. A server starts as a program on this computer or is reached by an address. Its tools ask for permission like the others.
ext.mcp_command: Start command (npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem C:\Data) or an address https://…
ext.tg_sub: Commands from your phone through your bot. The bot listens to one account only. Questions about actions come there too, with buttons.
ext.tg_token_saved: the token is saved in Credential Manager
ext.tg_user: Your numeric ID (@userinfobot will show it)
ext.tg_voice_in_sub: A voice message of up to {minutes} min goes to the speech recognition provider: the same model that listens to the microphone (the “Voice” page), and this is paid, even if the recording holds only silence or noise. The bot shows the recognised text and carries it out as an ordinary command: the same account, the same questions about actions with buttons. The question itself cannot be answered by voice. Forwarded voice messages and those recorded more than 5 minutes ago are not carried out.
ext.tg_voice_no_stt: No speech recognition model is set (the “Voice” page): the bot will answer a voice message with an error.
ext.tg_voice_reply_sub: The reply to a voice message comes as text and then as a voice message. It is made by the provider voice from the “Voice” page: the text of the reply goes to the speech synthesis provider, and this is paid. No more than 500 characters are spoken: of a long reply the beginning, the rest is in the text. Mika answers text messages with text only.
ext.tg_voice_no_tts: Right now the Windows voice speaks or no synthesis model is set: there will be no voice replies. Pick a provider voice on the “Voice” page.
ext.tg_voice_no_ffmpeg: FFmpeg was not found. A voice that gives sound only in WAV (as Gemini TTS does) will send the reply as a sound file, not as a voice message. With FFmpeg (the “Tools” page) it becomes a voice message.
voice.speak_sub: The reply is read sentence by sentence while it is still being written. A new message, a voice recording and the “Stop” button cut the speech short.
voice.voice_auto: Auto (the language in “Speech language”, if installed)
voice.test_phrase: Hi! This is {name}. This is how I sound.
voice.test_phrase_expressive: [cheerful] Hi! This is {name}. <whisper>This is how I sound.</whisper>
voice.none: No voice was found in Windows. Add a language with speech in “Settings → Time & language → Speech”.
voice.no_russian: There is no voice for the language in “Speech language” (English when it is empty): a voice of another language will read the text. Add speech for that language in “Settings → Time & language → Speech”.
general.report_sub: Collects the version, settings without keys and the end of the log. Nothing is sent anywhere: you can copy the text and send it yourself.
backup.title: Move to another PC
backup.sub: A backup in one file: settings and character, the chat, memory, notes, the to-do list, reminders, scheduled tasks, custom commands, event scenarios, permission rules. The log, the phrase cache, FFmpeg, the Vosk model, the browser profile, the cost record and the day log are not in the backup. Neither is the data for search by meaning: on the new PC Mika computes it again through the embeddings provider, and this is paid.
backup.protect: Encrypt with a password and include the keys
backup.protect_sub: The whole file is encrypted. Provider keys, the Telegram and MCP tokens and the calendar link go only into an encrypted backup.
backup.no_keys: Without a password the file is not encrypted and holds no keys. Anyone who gets the file can read the chat, the notes and the settings. On the new PC the keys will have to be entered again.
backup.password_hint: At least {min} characters, better a phrase of several words. The password is not kept anywhere: without it the backup cannot be opened.
backup.saved_keys: Encrypted with a password. Keys inside: {count}.
backup.file_encrypted: Encrypted with a password. Keys inside: {count}.
backup.file_plain: Not encrypted, there are no keys in it.
backup.file_newer: The backup was made by a newer version. Some of the data may not be carried over.
backup.preview_sub: What is ticked will replace what is on this PC.
backup.rules_allow_sub: With these rules {name} does what is listed without asking. Tick them only if the backup is yours and you know the rules.
backup.rules_more: Not shown and will not be restored: {count} more.
backup.rules_deny_sub: “Forbid” rules from the backup are added to those of this PC. Your own ones stay.
backup.tasks_sub: {name} carries out these tasks herself when the time comes: the text of a task goes to the model as if you had written it, and this is a paid request. Overdue ones will fire right after the restore. Tick them only if the backup is yours and you know the tasks.
backup.tasks_more: Not shown and will not be restored: {count} more.
backup.scenarios_sub: {name} carries out a scenario herself when something happens on the computer, and every run of it is a paid request to the model. So scenarios come back turned off and without a run count: turn on the ones you need on the “Extensions” page. Scenarios from the backup will replace the scenarios of this PC. A scenario that runs a custom command comes back only if that command is restored too or is already here; the text of the command is shown under the scenario on the “Extensions” page, read it before you turn the scenario on. “Tell me when…” watches are not in the backup.
backup.scenario: “{name}”: when {when} — {action}; pause {pause}, up to {max} a day
backup.scenario_no_command: With this choice it will not come back: after the restore this PC will not have the command “{command}”.
backup.scenarios_more: Not shown and will not be restored: {count} more.
backup.rules_dropped: Rules with “*” inside the pattern dropped: {count}.
backup.key_replaces: will replace the key on this PC
backup.address_warn: Now it is {current}. The key that is already on this PC will be sent to the address from the backup.
backup.mcp_warn: On this PC the server with this name has another address, or there is no such server. Once the server is turned on, the token that is already on this PC will be sent to the address from the backup.
backup.telegram_warn: On this PC the owner is different. Once the bridge is turned on, the bot whose token is already on this PC will obey the owner from the backup.
backup.off_sub: Everything that listens, looks, watches, goes online by itself, starts programs or takes commands from outside is restored turned off. Turn on what you need in the settings.
backup.off.events: Event scenarios: they are paused here
backup.off.journal_content: Texts and arguments in the log
backup.off.scenarios: Event scenarios: {count}. They are turned on on the “Extensions” page
backup.docs_folders: Document folders from the backup: {folders}. Add the ones you need again on the “Tools” page.
backup.kept: The look and place of the window, the path to FFmpeg, the deep search reports folder and the update address stay as on this PC. Tool groups that are off here stay off. The pause of paid work at a reached cost limit is not turned off by a backup: while it is on here and a limit is set, cost tracking, the limits, the currency and your own prices stay as on this PC. Autostart is not carried over.
backup.safety: The previous data, without keys, will be saved in {path}.
backup.restore_sure: Really restore: what is ticked will replace the data of this PC
backup.done_keys_failed: Keys that were not written: {list}. Enter them in the settings.
backup.done_scenarios_skipped: Scenarios not restored: {count}. The custom command they run is not on this PC.
backup.restart_needed: For everything to work, {name} has to be restarted.
backup.welcome_link: I have a backup from another PC
error.backup_busy: A backup is already being saved or restored
error.backup_password_short: The password is shorter than {min} characters
error.backup_password_long: The password is longer than {max} characters
error.backup_password_needed: The backup is encrypted, a password is needed
error.backup_not_backup: This is not a backup file
error.backup_newer: The backup was made by a newer version (format {format}). Update the app and try again
error.backup_unsupported: The backup has unknown encryption parameters, it cannot be opened
error.backup_damaged: The backup file is damaged or was changed
error.backup_too_big: The backup file is larger than allowed
error.backup_read: The backup file cannot be read: {why}
error.backup_write: The backup file was not written: {why}
error.backup_keys: Credential Manager did not give the keys, the backup was not saved
error.backup_db: The database answered with an error: {why}
error.backup_safety: The previous data could not be saved, the restore was not started: {why}
error.backup_expired: The backup file has to be chosen again
error.backup_changed: The backup file changed after the preview. Choose it again
error.backup_dialog: The file dialog did not open
error.model_not_glb: This is not a model file: a .vrm file is needed
error.model_not_vrm: The file has no VRM data. Only a model in the VRM format will do
error.model_too_big: The model file is bigger than 200 MB
error.model_external: The model refers to files outside itself. Such a model is not loaded
error.model_unsupported: The model requires an extension that is not supported: {name}
error.model_bad_still: The portraits of the model were not saved: they are not PNG pictures
error.model_bad_name: The name is empty or another animation has it
error.motion_too_big: The animation file is bigger than 20 MB
error.motion_not_vrma: This is not a VRMA animation: a .vrma file is needed
error.model_io: The model file could not be read or written
error.journal_clear: The log was not cleared completely: {why}
error.mic_off: The microphone is off. Turn on the “Microphone” switch in the chat header.
error.stt_off: No speech recognition model is set: settings, the “Voice” page.
providers.speech_hint: Speech recognition and speech synthesis are set up on the “Voice” page.
voice.cache_sub: A repeated phrase in the same voice is taken from disk and is not ordered from the provider again. {size} MB of 100 used.
voice.provider_sub: The text of every phrase goes to the provider. If it does not answer, the Windows voice reads the phrase.
voice.mic_sub: Recording starts with the microphone button in the input field or with {shortcut}, and ends by itself when you fall silent. The sound of the phrase goes to the speech recognition provider.
voice.mic_missing: Windows does not see a microphone: connect one or pick a recording device in the sound settings.
chat.pin_title: Pin: the island at the top of the screen again
chat.drag_title: Drag to move. Drop it below the top edge and it becomes a window; drop it at the top edge and it is the island again
island.monitor_sub: You can also just drag the island to another monitor: it sticks to the top edge.
error.update_url: The address of the update file must start with https://
error.update_none: There is no new version: check for updates first
voice.wake_sub: The name is heard by a recognizer on this computer; no sound leaves it. It is built for Russian speech, so a name in Latin letters may not be heard. Say “{name}”: she stops talking if she was speaking and starts listening. What you say next is recognised by the provider.
voice.wake_on: Listening for “{name}”. If she does not answer, check that Windows has speech recognition installed for the language set in “Speech language”.
voice.wake_on_vosk: Listening for “{name}” with the Vosk model.
voice.duck_sub: While she listens and speaks, other programs sound quieter. The volume returns a second and a half after the end. The spoken Russian words “stop” or “khvatit” interrupt her speech (with Vosk).
voice.style_sub: For a speech model that understands a description of the voice, such as openai/gpt-4o-mini-tts: age, timbre, manner. Other models skip the description. Copies of the voices of other characters and actors are not made: Mika has her own voice.
voice.style_placeholder: A young female voice, soft and warm, speaking unhurriedly, with a smile
voice.brief_sub: She says a short reply in full. She does not read out a long one: the same model makes a retelling of one or two phrases, and she says that instead. A joke, a poem or a story you asked her to tell is read in full: the model decides that herself. While a task goes step by step she keeps quiet and says only the outcome or why the task broke off.
voice.expressive_sub: For the Fish Audio Drama 3 model (fish-audio/drama-3). Mika marks up replies for the voice: remarks, whisper, pauses. The markup is not shown in the chat.
voice.expressive_other_model: The saved synthesis model is not Drama 3: the markup will not turn on.
voice.mood_sub: The Windows voice slightly changes pitch and pace together with her face: higher when she is glad, lower and slower when she is sad. A speech model of the provider gets a line about the mood.
voice.mood_dir_sub: For Fish Audio Drama 3 with expressive speech. To a phrase that has no markup of its own Mika adds a remark that fits her mood: joy, sadness, worry. It is not shown in the chat. This is up to 25 characters per phrase, and they are paid for. The mood cannot be passed to other provider voices this way; the Windows voice changes pitch and pace with the “Tone by mood” switch.
voice.mood_dir_needs: “Expressive speech” and the Drama 3 model are needed: the remark is not added now.
voice.follow_up_sub: If the question was asked by voice, she listens again for a few seconds after the reply: you can ask more without calling her. Silence, text in the chat or “Stop” end the conversation.
voice.vosk_off: Right now the name is heard by the Windows recognizer: it needs a speech pack and makes more mistakes. The Vosk model hears the name in any voice and does not mix it up with similar words; it understands Russian speech only. It is downloaded once from alphacephei.com and GitHub, about 60 MB, and takes about 140 MB on disk.
voice.vosk_on: The name is heard by the Vosk model. {size} MB used.
voice.wake_needs_mic: Turn on “Microphone” for the phrase to work.
welcome.lead: Two steps and we can start. All of this can be changed later in the settings.
welcome.provider_lead: Set a service with a model and a key. The key is kept in Windows Credential Manager.
welcome.privacy_lead: Everything is off until you turn it on. Before every action I will still ask for permission.
welcome.mic_sub: Voice input by the button or with a keyboard shortcut. The sound of the phrase goes to the speech recognition provider.
general.update_sub: The current version is {version}. Updates are looked for at the address of a file that describes the version. Download and install happen only by the button.
general.update_sure: Really install {version}: the app will restart
general.update_unsigned: The installer is not signed with a certificate: Windows may warn when it starts. The checksum of the file is checked.
ext.mcp_token: Access token, if the server asks for one
